note: CLN3-associated isolated retinal degeneration commonly displays prominent early macular involvement, including atrophic changes and macular edema, distinct from classic retinitis pigmentosa.

evidence.text: Patients with isolated nonsyndromic retinal disease due to CLN3 variants exhibited early onset or severe retinal degeneration characterized by significant macular involvement, including macular edema and widespread atrophy.

source.title: Detailed Clinical Phenotype and Molecular Genetic Findings in CLN3-Associated Isolated Retinal Degeneration
source.quote: CLN3-associated isolated retinal degeneration shows greater macular involvement than the rod-cone degeneration of retinitis pigmentosa.

numbers.metric: earlier onset rod-cone dystrophy cohort size

evidence.text: Among 15 patients with isolated retinal degeneration harboring biallelic CLN3 variants, a severe form marked by early macular atrophic changes was documented.

source.title: Retinal Phenotype of Patients With Isolated Retinal Degeneration Due to CLN3 Pathogenic Variants in a French Retinitis Pigmentosa Cohort
source.quote: Two distinct patterns of retinal disease could be identified: a mild rod-cone degeneration of middle-age onset (n = 6; legal blindness threshold reached by 70s) and a severe retinal degeneration with early macular atrophic changes (n = 9; legal blindness threshold reached by 40s).

numbers.metric: patients with early macular atrophic changes
